diagnosis.rationale: Additive feature with no unresolved defect; runtime failures may still route to diagnosis.

dsa.rationale: Runner representation, ordering, persistence, idempotency, complexity, and rollback were assessed and incorporated into r2.

tdd.rationale: Observable behaviors, Red order, test levels, fake-event boundaries, and crash-window tests were incorporated into r2.

security.rationale: Explicit authorization, hard safety stops, bounded prompts/checkpoints, and path/hash validation were incorporated into r2.

migration.rationale: Additive state versioning, absence/future-version semantics, compatibility, and rollback were incorporated into r2.

performance.rationale: The initial design serializes one bounded runner; measure before specialized storage or scheduling.

accessibility-ux.rationale: Text commands and notifications preserve existing Pi TUI conventions; no new custom UI.

operations.rationale: Pause/stop, single ownership, budgets, crash recovery, diagnostics, and explicit recovery were incorporated into r2.

compatibility.rationale: Existing command semantics, agent_settled, idle checks, prompt expansion, config, and API checks were incorporated into r2.
